assumptions_to_validate.assumption: Mid-market B2B SaaS sales leaders have sufficient lead volume to justify automated qualification.
assumptions_to_validate.test_method: Conduct 10 discovery calls with VPs of Sales in the target segment.
assumptions_to_validate.success_metric: 70%+ of respondents confirm spending >10 hours/week on manual research.

assumptions_to_validate.assumption: Personalized, pain-specific outreach outperforms standard industry templates.
assumptions_to_validate.test_method: Run an A/B test of 200 prospects split evenly between pain-specific copy and generic pitch.
assumptions_to_validate.success_metric: Achieve >= 6.5% positive reply rate on personalized variant vs < 2% on control.
